_doc: Schema for site-pack/topology/fiber-testing-ips.json — cp to topology/fiber-testing-ips.json and replace the fictional entries. Key = the 'Network/Fiber' value from a ticket's first note (lowercase). internal = the fiber router loopback to use as the bandwidth-test target (private path); public = the CGNAT/public-path test IP, or 'xxx' when there is none (then skip the private btest and test to the core edge instead); btest_user = only when that router needs a dedicated btest account (its password comes from the operator-supplied BTEST_PASSWORD env var, never from this file); dia_monitored = true when the network rides a monitored DIA/WireGuard tunnel; notes = free text. All values below are fictional.

romeo.notes: DIA over WireGuard: still btest to internal, note the VPN

november.notes: dedicated btest account; password from BTEST_PASSWORD

foxtrot.notes: no public test IP: skip the private btest and note a test to the core edge
